name: skill-issue
description: macOS interview assistant with local speech recognition and an encrypted web viewer.
author: Ruslan Khasanshin

scripts.lint:web: bun types:worker && ultracite check && bash scripts/format-config.sh check && stylelint --max-warnings 0 --ignore-path .gitignore 'web/**/*.css' && shfmt -d scripts/*.sh && bunx shellcheck scripts/*.sh
scripts.lint:swift: swift format lint --strict --recursive Package.swift native tests checks/native_relay.swift scripts/quit.swift && swiftlint lint --strict --quiet && swiftc -typecheck -swift-version 6 -warnings-as-errors scripts/quit.swift
scripts.lint: bun lint:web && bun lint:swift && bun check:plist
scripts.lint:fix:web: bun types:worker && ultracite fix && bash scripts/format-config.sh fix && stylelint --max-warnings 0 --fix --ignore-path .gitignore 'web/**/*.css' && shfmt -w scripts/*.sh
scripts.lint:fix:swift: swiftlint lint --fix --quiet && swift format format --in-place --recursive Package.swift native tests checks/native_relay.swift scripts/quit.swift
scripts.lint:fix: bun lint:fix:web && bun lint:fix:swift && bun lint:fix:plist
scripts.check:types: bun types:worker && tsc --pretty && tsc --pretty -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc --pretty -p relay/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:integration:web: bun playwright:install && playwright test --project=web && playwright test --project=relay
scripts.check:plist: plutil -lint scripts/Info.plist && plutil -convert xml1 -o - scripts/Info.plist | diff scripts/Info.plist -
scripts.check:web: bun lint:web && bun check:hooks && bun check:workflows && bun check:renovate && bun check:types && bun check:unused:web && bun check:vulns && bun test:coverage:web && bun check:integration:web
scripts.check:swift: bun lint:swift && bun check:plist && bun test:coverage:swift && bun check:unused:swift && bun build:release && bun check:integration:swift
scripts.prepare: if [ -n "${CI:-}" ] || [ "${LEFTHOOK:-}" = "0" ]; then exit 0; fi; lefthook install
